Wrong # of frets for bari uke. Sadly, this program doesn’t well for baritone ukulele. Yes, you can select ukulele for your instrument, and select baritone tuning, but the instrument you see does not have enough frets. The ukulele that you see in the training has 12 frets between the nut and where the neck joins the body. But on a baritone uke, it’s typically the 15th fret where the neck joints the body. You want to train your mind that at the 12th fret the notes are DGBE. But you do NOT want to train your mind to “see” this pattern in the wrong place, in relation to the body of the instrument. Any chance of adding a separate instrument for baritone ukulele? Or perhaps a feature where you could specify the number of frets?

Promising But Needs Additional Functionality. This is my updated review.

I like the look and feel of this App but am very disappointed at its limited functionality. 

I could not find any helpful instructions on how to adjust the settings. The user instructions should be expanded. 

This App has 4 modes: Training, Learn Staff, Game and Free Play. The first three modes ask you to either pick a note or pick a fret. One can move the 0 fret (like using a Capo) in the Training and Learn Staff modes. This feature does not function for the Game or Free Play modes.

In trying to learn the fretboard, I use Free Play exclusively. Because the zero fret cannot be moved in this mode one has to calculate the number of notes up from the zero fret. Also, one can only see one note at a time which means there is no chord functionality.

I would recommend that if chord functionality is added in a future release that strum and step arpeggio features be included.

Brilliant idea well worth getting. This a great app, I use it for teaching my guitar students as well as recommend it to them. If you use a lot of Tab, then this program is will help you to learn the note names on the fret board. A big missing in much of the guitar world as it is important. Consider Tab as like learning to drive a car, music notation like the road rules. Just because you can drive a car does not mean you can get out on the road with other drivers without knowing the rules of the road. This app is a step in the right direction for a better understanding of music and the guitar. :)
Lite version only. To practice anything past 5th fret, you must buy the app. This sort of thing just makes me delete immediately. Just ask for the cost straight up, don't lie about it!

Best available fretboard app. I have looked at many fretboard memorisation apps and this is the one I decided to recommend to my students. It is really easy, even for young kids! And is equally useful for us oldies.

Would be great though, if you could see more frets at one time, particularly the first five frets. Maybe something for the next version??? :-)
